name: Crystal
description: Crystalline Structure, Resonance, Refraction, Dream-matter, Memory. Crystal is ordered, resonant matter — the lattice that holds light, sound and even thought in perfect arrangement. Where Metal endures by density and Bones by structure, Crystal endures by pattern: it refracts, it rings, it remembers. Alone among the Cognitions of matter it can hold a thing that is not matter at all — light, force, the shape of a spell — sealed in a facet to be drawn out again. It is the truest enemy of Decay, and the Crystal Masters who work Aeon Crystals are, knowingly or not, its students.

minor.name: Brittle
minor.card: the next hit against it deals +1d8 piercing

severe.name: Encased
severe.card: Petrified in crystal — a hit of {DC}+ damage cracks it free

offensive.name: Prismatic Shards
offensive.description: The light does not pass through. It chooses a second throat to open.

tiers.text: The damage becomes piercing and increases by 1 additional die. Each creature the seal damages refracts a beam to one other creature of your choice within 15 feet of it. That creature takes half the damage the first one took, as piercing — no attack roll and no save. A creature takes refracted damage only once per seal, and refracted damage never refracts again.
tiers.card: +1 die · damage becomes Piercing · each creature damaged refracts HALF what it took to 1 other creature within 15 ft (no save, once per creature)

tiers.text: The damage increases by 2 additional dice and each beam refracts to two other creatures. A lodged shard works deeper: each creature damaged by the seal or by a refraction takes Twice your Verum Modifier in piercing damage at the start of its next turn.
tiers.card: +2 dice · refracts to 2 creatures · everyone damaged or refracted takes 2×VM piercing at the start of their next turn

tiers.text: The damage increases by 3 additional dice. When the seal reduces a creature to 0 hit points or scores a critical hit against it, crystal bursts from it: every other creature within 10 feet of it takes half the damage it took, as piercing — no save. A creature takes burst damage only once per seal.
tiers.card: +3 dice · a creature dropped or crit bursts — half what it took to every other creature within 10 ft (no save)

tiers.text: Cascade. The damage increases by 4 additional dice. Each creature the seal damages now refracts to every enemy within 15 feet of it, rather than to two. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by a refraction or a burst also bursts, and also refracts what it took. The chain runs until nothing more drops; each creature still takes refracted damage only once and burst damage only once.
tiers.card: +4 dice · CASCADE — refracts to EVERY enemy within 15 ft · anything a refraction or burst drops bursts and refracts onward

offensive.name: Resonant Overload
offensive.description: Every struck note is stored. You are only waiting to hear the chord.

tiers.text: The damage becomes piercing and increases by 2 additional dice. Each creature it damages gains 1 Resonance, to a maximum of your Verum Modifier. Resonance lasts 1 minute from the last stack gained. As a bonus action on any of your turns, you may shatter the Resonance on one creature you can see: it loses all its stacks and takes 1d6 piercing per stack — no attack roll and no save.
tiers.card: +2 dice · +1 Resonance (max {VM}, 1 min) · bonus action: shatter a creature you can see for 1d6 piercing per stack, no save

tiers.text: The damage increases by 3 additional dice, each creature it damages gains 2 Resonance instead of 1, and shattering deals 1d8 per stack.
tiers.card: +3 dice · +2 Resonance per creature damaged · shatter 1d8 per stack

tiers.text: The damage increases by 4 additional dice and shattering deals 1d10 per stack. When a shatter reduces a creature to 0 hit points, the resonance jumps: the nearest other creature within 15 feet of it gains Resonance equal to half the stacks shattered (rounded down), up to the usual maximum.
tiers.card: +4 dice · shatter 1d10 per stack · a shatter that kills jumps half the stacks to the nearest creature within 15 ft

tiers.text: The Chord. The damage increases by 6 additional dice. When a creature at maximum Resonance takes damage from any source, it shatters at once, with no action from you. Whenever a creature shatters this way, every other creature within 10 feet of it gains 2 Resonance. A single struck note can bring down a hall.
tiers.card: +6 dice · THE CHORD — at max Resonance, ANY damage shatters it, no action · every other creature within 10 ft gains 2 Resonance

supportive.name: Resonant Reliquary
supportive.description: A crystal keeps what the world was careless enough to spill.

tiers.text: The target carries a Reliquary while the seal lasts, attuned to one damage type you choose when you draw the seal. The bearer has resistance to that type, and the crystal stores the damage that resistance prevents, up to a total of Twice your Verum Modifier. As an action, the bearer can hurl the store at a point within 30 feet: each creature within 10 feet of that point takes the stored amount as damage of that type (Constitution save against your Verum DC for half). This empties the store; the Reliquary remains and can fill again.
tiers.card: Resistance to one type · the crystal banks what it stops (max 2×VM) · action: hurl it 30 ft, 10-ft burst, Con save {DC} for half

tiers.text: The Reliquary stores up to Five Times your Verum Modifier. Once, when a spell targets only the bearer, the bearer may use its reaction to catch it: the spell has no effect and waits in the crystal. The bearer can release it as an action, choosing its targets, with the original caster's attack bonus and save DC. A caught spell is lost if the Reliquary ends first.
tiers.card: Banks up to 5×VM · reaction, once: catch a spell aimed only at the bearer, then release it as an action with its caster's numbers

tiers.text: You may seal one of your own spells or seals, of a level up to your Verum Modifier, into a Reliquary you touch: spend its casting time and its slot (and a use, for a seal) as if casting it, but it waits in the crystal instead. The bearer releases it as an action, choosing its targets, with your attack bonus and DC, and concentrates on it if it needs concentration. A Reliquary holds one sealed spell at a time.
tiers.card: Seal one of your spells (level ≤ {VM}) into it, paying its slot — the bearer releases it later with your numbers

tiers.text: A Vault of the Weave. The Reliquary no longer ends with the seal: once the Ring's duration has passed, it ends as soon as it is empty. It has no limit on the damage it stores, can catch any number of spells (still one reaction each), and holds any number of sealed spells. A spell released from it is cast as if with a slot one level higher.
tiers.card: A VAULT OF THE WEAVE — no cap, any number of spells, lasts until emptied · spells come out one slot higher

control.name: Crystalize
control.description: The stillness is not death. It is worse — it is being kept.

tiers.text: Living crystal erupts in a 10-foot radius and becomes difficult terrain. Each creature in the area when it erupts makes the seal's saving throw. A creature that fails is Restrained until it uses an action to break free with a successful Strength check against your Verum DC.
tiers.card: 10-ft crystal field, difficult terrain · fail: Restrained (Str check vs {DC} as an action to break)

conditions.name: Restrained
conditions.escape: Strength check vs Verum DC as an action

tiers.text: The radius grows to 15 feet, and a creature Restrained by the crystal takes Twice your Verum Modifier in piercing damage at the start of each of its turns as the crystal grows through it.
tiers.card: 15 ft · 2×VM piercing at the start of each turn while Restrained

tiers.text: A creature that fails by 5 or more is Encased instead of Restrained: it is Petrified in crystal, and no check frees it. It is freed when a single attack or effect deals damage to it equal to your Verum DC or more, counted before the Petrified condition's resistance, or when the seal ends. An Encased creature does not take the crystal's growth damage.
tiers.card: Fail by 5+: ENCASED, Petrified until one hit of {DC}+ damage (before resistance) cracks it

conditions.name: Petrified
conditions.escape: a single hit of damage ≥ Verum DC

tiers.text: The crystal answers you like a limb. For 1 minute, as a bonus action, you may do one of the following: move the field up to 30 feet; raise spires under one creature in the field that failed the seal's save and has since broken free, Restraining it again with no new save; or raise a wall of crystal inside the field, up to 15 feet long and 10 feet high, that gives total cover and lasts as long as the field. A creature that stays Encased for the full minute is held in stasis — ageless and unaware — even after the seal ends, until the crystal is cracked as above.
tiers.card: 1 min: bonus action to move it 30 ft, raise spires (re-Restrain one who failed, no save), or raise a 15-ft wall · a full minute Encased = stasis

control.name: Refraction Field
control.description: Aim all you like. The room disagrees about where anyone is standing.

tiers.text: Hanging facets fill a 15-foot radius for 1 minute. Ranged attacks that pass into or through it have disadvantage, and it is lightly obscured by scattered light.
tiers.card: 15-ft field, 1 min · ranged attacks into or through it at disadvantage · lightly obscured

penalty.disadvantage: ranged attacks into or through the field

tiers.text: Each creature in the field when it appears makes the seal's saving throw; one that fails is Blinded until the end of its next turn. As an action you may flare the field: every creature that failed that save and is still inside is Blinded again until the end of its next turn, with no new save.
tiers.card: Fail: Blinded until the end of their next turn · action: flare to Blind them again, no new save

conditions.name: Blinded
conditions.duration: until the end of its next turn

tiers.text: The field redirects. Once per round, when a ranged attack made from outside the field misses a creature inside it, you may reflect it — no action required — at another creature of your choice in the field. Use the same attack roll against the new target's AC.
tiers.card: 1/round, a ranged miss from outside is reflected at a creature of your choice in the field (same roll, no action)

tiers.text: The facets drink the light of magic itself. When a spell is cast into or through the field, its caster must succeed on a spellcasting check (d20 + spellcasting ability modifier + Proficiency Bonus) against your Verum DC or the spell is refracted: each of its targets is replaced by a random creature in the field, friend or foe alike, and a spell with an area is centred on a random creature in the field instead.
tiers.card: Spells into it need a spellcasting check vs {DC} — or their targets (or centre) are rerolled at random in the field

creation.name: Living Lattice
creation.description: What you grow does not rot. It rings when struck, and remembers.

tiers.text: Your creations are living crystal: they have resistance to piercing and slashing damage, can't rot or corrode, and shed dim light in a 10-foot radius that you can turn on or off at will.
tiers.card: Crystal creations: resist piercing and slashing · never rot or corrode · shed dim light at will

tiers.text: Your Structures ring: while you are on the same plane as one, you hear anything spoken within 30 feet of it. Your Constructs refract: when a ranged attack misses one, you may reflect it at another creature of your choice within 10 feet of the Construct, using the same attack roll.
tiers.card: Hear through your Structures anywhere on the plane · a ranged miss on your Constructs reflects (same roll)

tiers.text: Your Objects remember. Each may hold one of the following: a memory of up to 1 minute, a spoken message, or one spell of a level up to your Verum Modifier, which you cast into it with its slot spent as normal. Whoever holds the Object can release what it holds as an action; a released spell uses your attack bonus and DC.
tiers.card: Objects hold a memory, a message, or one stored spell (level ≤ {VM}) — the holder releases it as an action

tiers.text: A Structure grown from a 7th-level slot or higher is permanent, repairs itself fully each dawn, and counts as an Aeon Crystal for Crystal'ology.
tiers.card: 7th+ Structures are permanent, self-mending, and count as Aeon Crystals

utility.name: Crystal'ology
utility.description: The quiet craft of the Crystal Masters.

tiers.text: Grow a thumb-sized crystal that holds a light, a sound, or a sentence of speech until shattered. Or read any gem or crystal you touch: where it was cut, and whether it holds anything.
tiers.card: Grow a crystal that keeps a light, sound or sentence · read a gem's origin and contents

tiers.text: Grow a pair of linked crystals: whatever is spoken to one is heard from the other, at any distance on the same plane, for 24 hours.
tiers.card: Linked crystal pair — speak through them anywhere on the plane, 24 hrs

tiers.text: Lay a memory of your own — up to 10 minutes — into a crystal, whole and exact. Anyone who holds it can relive it. Or halt decay — rot, rust and spoilage — in an area up to the size of a room for a year.
tiers.card: Store 10 minutes of your memory in a crystal · or halt decay in a room for a year

tiers.text: Touch an Aeon Crystal and hear the fragment of the Collective it dreams: ask it one question, and it answers truly. Each crystal answers only once.
tiers.card: Ask an Aeon Crystal one question — it answers truly, once per crystal

complementEffects.name: Prism
complementEffects.description: One wound, cut twice by the same light.

effect.text: On a hit or failed saving throw, the target takes extra piercing damage equal to one of the primary effect's damage dice (minimum 1d6). One other creature of your choice within 10 feet of it takes the same amount — no attack roll and no save.
effect.card: +1 die piercing · the beam refracts to 1 more creature within 10 ft for the same amount, no save

upgrades.text: Level 5+: Two dice, and the beam refracts to two other creatures.
Level 11+: Three dice, and each refracted beam may split once more, to one further creature within 10 feet of the one it struck, for the same amount.
upgrades.card: +3 dice · every beam splits once more

complementEffects.name: Reliquary
complementEffects.description: Keep a splinter of it. They will want it later.

effect.text: Each of the seal's targets carries a crystal splinter for 1 hour. A bearer can shatter its splinter in one of two ways: as a reaction when it takes damage, reducing that damage by your Verum Modifier + the slot level; or as a bonus action, regaining that many hit points. Either way the splinter is spent.
effect.card: The seal's targets each hold a splinter, 1 hr: shatter it to stop {VM} + {SLOT} damage, or heal that much

upgrades.text: Level 5+: The splinter holds Twice your Verum Modifier + the slot level.
Level 11+: The splinter lasts until used, and shattering it as a reaction also grants resistance to that damage's type until the end of the bearer's next turn.
upgrades.card: Lasts until used · shattering it as a reaction grants resistance to that type

complementEffects.name: Brittle
complementEffects.description: Half a statue already. The rest is only a matter of pressure.

effect.text: A creature hit by or failing the seal has its speed reduced by 10 feet until the end of your next turn and is Brittle for the same time. The next attack to hit a Brittle creature deals +1d8 piercing as the crust shatters, which ends Brittle but not the speed reduction.
effect.card: −10 ft speed · Brittle: the next hit on them deals +1d8 piercing

upgrades.text: Level 5+: −15 feet, and the shatter deals +2d8.
Level 11+: If the hit that shatters Brittle is a critical hit, the creature is also Restrained until the end of its next turn.
upgrades.card: A crit on them also Restrains until the end of their next turn
